description:
Where the forced orders sit around the current price for one market, from
every wallet on the node: liquidation prices (longs below = forced sells,
shorts above = forced buys), resting stop-loss / take-profit trigger orders,
and order-book depth, summed into price bands either side of the mark price,
plus the biggest liquidation clusters.

This is the "liquidation heatmap" question: where would a move run into
cascading liquidations, and how much is there. Uses 2 API calls.
